about: Sofa's own free channels: on every Sofa (and a Sofa Box) from the start, until someone switches them off under Server, Live TV. Only channels their broadcaster streams free, for anyone, on its own website, played as they are. Each one needs: name, url (an https HLS stream from the broadcaster's own servers), group, publisher, page (the broadcaster's own https page that offers the stream), kind, rights, and the check: python3 tools/demo-seed.py channels sofa/freechannels.json --check writes cors and checked. Never a FAST service's stream (Pluto, Samsung TV Plus, Plex, The Roku Channel, Tubi, Xumo and the like), a made-up browser name or referrer, a stream blocked outside its country, or a copy of a channel from anywhere but its broadcaster. Picked from Free-TV/IPTV's list and checked one by one.
